validation_notes: Processed 15 people total: 14 unique CSV people plus Alexander Pyatigor added only as the confirmed 2024 year-end CEO. Local documents checked: 2 files in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/MSRS. Research rounds completed: 2 per person (round 1: local filings + CSV reconciliation; round 2, 2026-07-28: targeted gap-fill + GICS/qualification_degree/institution-normalization). Education не удалось подтвердить or only weakly disclosed (round 1) for Alexander Pyatigor, Vsevolod Ivanov, Irina Alekhina, Lilia Shelest, and Sergey Grischenko; round 2 closed the Pyatigor, Ivanov, Shelest and Grischenko education/career gaps via industry biographies (energostrana.ru/eepir.ru, peretok.ru, ruscable.ru, wiki.letopis.ru); Irina Alekhina's education remains unresolved after two rounds of targeted search. Gasan Gasangadzhiev and Yuri Goncharov use secondary education sources; round 2 filled Gasangadzhiev's graduation year/field via viperson.ru. Weak sources were used for low-disclosure or historical profiles: MarketScreener, BusinessInsider/Finanzen-style mirrors, GlobalMSK, Energostrana, peretok.ru (search-snippet only, direct fetch unreachable), and official Telegram. Main conflicts: CSV lists Peter Sinyutin as CEO, while the official 2024 annual report says he was CEO/Chairman of the Management Board until 11.09.2024 and Alexander Pyatigor from 12.09.2024; several CSV board members are historical and are absent from the 2024 Board composition. Namesakes excluded include Oleg Vladimirovich Ivanov of the 2024 Management Board, unrelated Irina Alekhina profiles, unrelated Lilia Shelest profiles, and common-name Yuri Goncharov profiles without Rosseti markers. Genuine inconsistency handled without fabrication: Yevgeniy Logovinskiy's MBA graduation year has an internal contradiction within mbaconsult.ru itself (narrative says 2006, summary line says 2007) -- left null per task rules rather than guessing. Quality-pass round 1 (2026-07-30): compared the on-disk file against git HEAD and found it already exceeded HEAD (a prior session had applied most of round 2's findings to the JSON but left five people -- Irina Alekhina, Lilia Shelest, Gasan Gasangadzhiev, Yuri Goncharov, Larisa Romanovskaya -- desynced, i.e. their round-2 research_notes findings were never written into the JSON); restored all five (institution normalization, education year/field, new professional_experience entries, source citations) by cross-checking every fact against the actual round-2 .md files and, where feasible, re-verifying the underlying source via a fresh WebFetch this round (viperson.ru for Gasangadzhiev, confirmed verbatim; peretok.ru for Shelest, still ECONNREFUSED, kept at the same reduced confidence). Corrected one genuine GICS mislabel: Gasangadzhiev's ПАО «МОЭСК» board-membership entry had industry="Gas Utilities" (evidently a copy-paste meant for the missing АО «МОСГАЗ» entry) -- fixed to "Electric Utilities" and added the missing МОСГАЗ entry itself (Utilities/Utilities/Gas Utilities, 2009-2017 Генеральный директор). No other GICS triples in this file were found to be incorrect on inspection against gics_taxonomy.json. Gap follow-up attempted for Irina Alekhina's education (WebFetch on rossetimr.ru's official contacts page returned 403 Forbidden; WebSearch was unavailable, session quota exhausted) -- still unresolved, documented for a future pass. No previously confirmed fact, professional_experience/education description, or source citation was shortened or deleted in this round; two leftover temp comparison files used for the git-HEAD diff check were removed from the project root after the check.
